spans.s: ज्ञ [jña], a. [ज्ञा-क] (At the end of comp.)
Knowing, familiar with; कार्यज्ञ, निमित्तज्ञ, शास्त्रज्ञ, सर्वज्ञ &c.
Wise; as in ज्ञंमन्य thinking oneself to be wise.
ज्ञः A wise and learned man.
An epithet of Brahmā; cf. ज्ञः प्राज्ञे जन्द्रतनये विषये चात्मगर्वयोः Nm. -Comp. -शक्तिः the intellectual faculty.
ज्ञा [jñā], 9 U. (जानाति, जानीते, जज्ञौ, जज्ञे, अज्ञासीत्-अज्ञास्त, ज्ञातुम्, ज्ञात)
To know (in all senses), to learn, become acquainted with; मा ज्ञासीस्त्वं सुखी रामो यदकार्षीत् स रक्षसाम्
To know, be aware of, be familiar or conversant with; जाने तपसो वीर्यम् Ś.3.1; जानन्नपि हि मेधावी जडवल्लोक आचरेत्
To find out, ascertain, investigate; ज्ञायतां कः कः कार्यार्थीति
To comprehend, apprehend, understand, feel, experience; as in दुःखज्ञ, सुखज्ञ &c.
To test, try, know the true character of; आपत्सु मित्रं जानीयात्
To recognise; न त्वं दृष्ट्वा न पुनरलकां ज्ञास्यसे कामचारिन्
To regard, consider, know to be; जानामि त्वां प्रकृतिपुरुषं कामरूपं मघोनः
To act, engage in (with gen. of the instrument); सर्पिषो जानीते Sk. 'he engages in sacrifice with clarified butter (सर्पिषः = सर्पिषा).
To recognise as one's own, take possession of. -Caus. (ज्ञापयति, ज्ञपयति)
To announce, inform, make acquainted with, make known, notify.
To desire to know, investigate, ascertain;
ज्ञपित [jñapita] ज्ञप्त [jñapta], ज्ञप्त a. Made known, informed, expounded, taught.
ज्ञापित [jñāpita], a. Made known, informed, announced, declared.
ज्ञंमन्य [jñammanya], a. Thinking oneself to be wise; निश्चिन्वते हि ज्ञंमन्या यमेवायोग्यमाग्रहात् Rāj.
ज्ञात [jñāta], a. [ज्ञा-कर्मणि-क्त] Known, ascertained, understood, learnt, comprehended &c.; आज्ञापय ज्ञातविशेष पुंसां
; see ज्ञा above. -तम् Knowledge. -Comp. -अन्वयः Son of a known family. -सिद्धान्तः a man completely versed in any Śāstra.
A paternal relation, a father, brother &c.; agnate relatives collectively.
A kinsman or kindred in general.
A distant kinsman who is not entitled to the oblations offered to deceased ancestors.
A father. -Comp. -कर्मन् n., -कार्यम् the duty of a kinsman. -चेलम् A low-born person; विभिन्न- कर्माशयवाक् कुले नो मा ज्ञातिचेलं भुवि कस्यचिद् भूत् ।
.-प्रायः A meal for kinsmen (Mar. जातिभोजन); प्रक्षाल्य हस्ता- वाचम्य ज्ञातिप्रायं प्रकल्पयेत्
. -भावः kin, relationship. -भेदः dissension among relatives. -विद् a. one who has or makes near relatives.
ज्ञातेयम् [jñātēyam], Relationship, an act befitting a relative; ज्ञातेयं कुरु सौमित्रे भयात् त्रायस्व राघवम् ।
Consisting of knowledge, spiritual; इतरो दहने स्वकर्मणां ववृते ज्ञानमयेन वह्निना
Knowing, understanding, becoming acquainted with, proficiency; सांख्यस्य योगस्य च ज्ञानम्
Knowledge, learning; तथेन्द्रियाकुलीभावे ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन शुध्यति
knowingly or unknowingly, consciously or unconsciously.

Sacred knowledge; especially, knowledge derived from meditation on the higher truths of religion and philosophy which teaches man how to understand his own nature and how he may be reunited to the Supreme Spirit (opp. कर्मन्); cf. ज्ञानयोग and कर्मयोग in
The organ of intelligence, sense, intellect; कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रसन्नानि तवाच्युत
Means of knowing; औत्पक्तिकस्तु शब्दस्यार्थेन सम्बन्धस्तस्य ज्ञानम्˚ ।
An opinion, a view; बलदेवस्य वाक्यं तु मम ज्ञाने न युज्यते

thinking, reflection. -आत्मन् a. all wise. -इन्द्रियम् an organ of perception; (these are five त्वच्, रसना, चक्षुस्, कर्ण and घ्राण- the skin, tongue, eye, ear and nose; see बुद्धीन्द्रिय under इन्द्रिय). -काण्डम् that inner or esoteric portion of Veda which refers to true spiritual knowledge, or knowledge of the Supreme spirit, as distinguished from the knowledge of ceremonial rites (opp. कर्मकाण्ड). -कृत a. done knowingly or intentionally. -गम्य a. attainable by the understanding. -घन m. pure or mere knowledge; निर्विशेषाय साम्याय नमो ज्ञानघनाय च
; तं त्वामहं ज्ञानघनं...कथं...परिभावयामि ibid 9.8.24. -चक्षुस् n. the eye of intelligence, the mind's eye, intellectual vision (opp. चर्मचक्षुस्); सर्वं तु समवेक्ष्येदं निखिलं ज्ञानचक्षुषा

;4.24. (-m.) a wise and learned man.-तत्त्वम् true knowledge, knowledge of God. -तपस् n. penance consisting in the acquisition of true knowledge.-दः a preceptor. -दा an epithet of Sarasvatī. -दुर्बल a. wanting in knowledge. -निश्चयः certainty, ascertainment. -निष्ठ a. intent on acquiring true (spiritual) knowledge; ज्ञानिनिष्ठा द्विजाः केचित्
a teacher, preceptor. -पूर्व a. preceded by knowledge, well-considered; निष्कामं ज्ञानपूर्वं तु निवृत्तमुपदिश्यते

. -बोधिनी f. N. of a Vedāntic treatise. -मुद्र a. 'having the impress of wisdom', wise.-मूल a. founded on spiritual knowledge. -यज्ञः a man possessed of true or spiritual knowledge, philosopher.-योगः contemplation as the principal means of, attaining the Supreme spirit or acquiring true or spiritual knowledge; ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेण योगिनाम्
लक्षणम्, णा indication, sign, a means of knowing or inferring.
(in logic) sign or proof of knowledge; subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge.
विज्ञानम् sacred and miscellaneous knowledge; तत्प्राज्ञेन विनीतेन ज्ञानविज्ञानवेदिना
the Vedas with the supplementary branches of knowledge, such as medicine, arms &c. -वृद्ध advanced in knowledge; ज्ञानवृद्धो वयोबालो मृदुर्वीर्यगुणान्वितः
साधनम् a means of acquiring true or spiritual knowledge.
ज्ञानित्वम् [jñānitvam], Fortune-telling; तेषां च कुहकाभिज्ञो ज्ञानित्वमुप- दर्शयन्
ज्ञानिन् [jñānin], a. (-नी f.) [ज्ञानमस्त्यस्य इनि] Intelligent, wise. -m.
An astrologer, fortune-teller; यदुवाचाग्निदाहादि स ज्ञानी भावि पृच्छताम्
A sage, one possessed of spiritual knowledge; आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भसतर्षभ
ज्ञानीयति [jñānīyati], Den. P. To wish for knowledge.
ज्ञापक [jñāpaka], a. [ज्ञा-णिच् ल्यु] Making known, teaching, informing, indicating &c.
A master of requests, an officer of the court of an Indian prince;
. -कम् (In phil.) A significant expression, a suggestive rule or precept, said of such rules as imply something more than what is actually expressed by the words of those rules themselves.
ज्ञापनम् [jñāpanam], [ज्ञा णिच्-ल्युट्] Making known, informing, teaching, announcing, indicating; क्षितिभृद्दाक्षिणात्यानां तिर्यक्त्वज्ञापनाय सः Rāj.
